entries.baseline: Control agreements on the slice: Positive_Correlation 7/17, Negative_Correlation 4/15, Association 24/30
entries.content: Candidate T2a — Association-specialist second pass carrying the boundary-contrast definitions, applied to ctrl's Association affirmations
entries.decision: 2026-10-19 — operating point none (not adopted); the round-9 design record (§13)
entries.delta: Correlation legs nearly repaired (PosCorr 16/17, NegCorr 12/15) paid for on the mirror: gold Association agreement collapses 24/30 -> 6/30 (18 agrees broken); net agreement vs ctrl -1; flip audit uphold 0.30 (3 correct / 7 incorrect / 0 cannot-tell, seeded sample of 10 of 172 flips)
entries.gate: G-R9c2 (net >= +5 and >= T2b + 3; Association agrees broken <= 2; flip-audit uphold >= 0.50)
entries.population: Pilot slice — ctrl's 254 Association affirmations; slice readings on ctrl's 63 converted pairs (the pilot design record)
entries.treatment: Candidate T2a arm (172 of 254 affirmations flipped)
entries.verdict: FAIL on every leg — NOT ADOPTED (F-R9-4, mirror symmetry). The definitions carry real correlation signal and demonstrably break the Association side at this tier: the boundary is a trade-off curve, and choosing an operating point on it is a human decision, not a measurement result. No winner is picked from this curve. DECIDED 2026-10-19 under the recorded close-out instruction (wrap the open decisions without human intervention/review): operating point = NONE — T2a is not adopted at any point on the curve; the pipeline keeps the single J3 judge as-is. Basis: G-R9c2 failed every leg and the flip-audit uphold was 0.30; no measured point on the curve clears the round's own registered gate.

entries.content: Candidate T2b — definitions-free second-look specialist (control arm for T2a)
entries.gate: G-R9c2 (as the control leg of CR-5)
entries.verdict: FAIL — NOT ADOPTED. A definitions-free second look does not separate from noise; the T2a effect in CR-5 is therefore attributable to the definitions, in both directions.
